abstract: Possible relationships between histopathologic cell type and several clinical variables were examined in 253 patients with Stage III nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. No statistically significant associations were found between cell type and either the side of primary tumor or cryptorchidism. The presence of elements of choriocarcinoma was associated with the presence of retroperitoneal tumor (P less than 0.03) but no other association between cell type and site of metastasis was encountered. Elevated serum levels of human chorionic gonadotropin were found in patients with elements of choriocarcinoma but serum levels of alphafetoprotein, lactate dehydrogenase and carcinoembryonic antigen were not correlated with a specific cell type. No statistically significant association was found between cell type and either complete response to combined modality therapy or survival. These results would indicate that cell type is probably not an important prognostic variable in patients with Stage III nonseminomatous tumors of the testis.
abstract_ja: 病期III非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者253例で、病理組織学的細胞型と他の臨床変数との関係を検討した。細胞型と原発巣の側、または停留精巣との間に統計学的に有意な関連は認められなかった。絨毛癌成分の存在は後腹膜腫瘍の存在と関連していた(P<0.03)が、細胞型と転移部位の間にはその他の関連は見られなかった。絨毛癌成分を有する患者ではヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の血清値が上昇していたが、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)、CEAの血清値は特定の細胞型と相関しなかった。細胞型と、併用療法に対する完全奏効または生存率との間にも統計学的に有意な関連は認められなかった。これらの結果から、病期III非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者において、細胞型は予後を規定する重要な変数ではないと考えられる。
